rotation.basis: day-of-year 286 (2026-10-13), day-of-month 13; pool size 34. Yesterday (doy 285) emphasized pool indices 28-33 + 0-10; today emphasizes the complementary slice, indices 11-27 (17 keywords: prior auth through rare disease).
rotation.method: Unattended-run override: working set = ALL 3 core + ENTIRE 34-keyword medicine pool (37 total). Rotation only sets EMPHASIS / naming order: today's 17 emphasized keywords get dedicated queries; the other 17 (yesterday's radiology/pathology/documentation/regulation/Korean slice) are merged into shared multi-keyword queries. Expansions shifted vs 2026-10-12 toward new sub-angles (specialty diagnosis, treatment, payer/liability, telehealth/nursing). No WebSearch used in planning.
rotation.notes: Scope per sources.json medicine _note: clinical/treatment only (trials, FDA 510(k)/De Novo/CE, hospital deployment, diagnosis/imaging, disease-specific drug discovery, SaMD, EHR/documentation, telehealth, prior auth, patient safety/bias/liability). Disease-unspecified biology/protein-structure models belong to science - drop unless a named disease/patient/clinician is reached; never put one story in both sections. Exclude funding/M&A/personnel, supplement ads, wellness-app promos. SAFETY: never pick pathogen gain-of-function / bioweapon-readable stories (swap, don't reword); vaccine/antibiotic design for treatment is fine. Fetch tips: JAMA RSS dates are issue dates (verify via Crossref); Korean feeds are KST without offset; prefer outlet RSS over site: search for recency.

recently_published_avoid.steer: Last three days were heavy on radiology (FDA device stats, mammography second reader, prostate MRI, lung nodule, body-composition MRI), pathology/cytology (pancreatic, cervical), trial-policy (SURPASS), in-house AI regulation (Gottlieb), and cancer-risk/diagnostic chatbots. Today's emphasized slice deliberately moves away: specialty diagnosis outside radiology (derm, eye, ECG/echo, genomics/rare disease), treatment (radiotherapy planning, surgical robots, AI-designed antibodies/antibiotics/cancer vaccines reaching patients), payer side (prior auth/claim denials), liability/bias, telehealth/RPM, nursing workload, LLM decision support at the bedside, and mental-health therapy trials/regulation (not more AI-psychosis reporting). Radiology/pathology/documentation queries remain but should surface NEW clearances or trials only, not follow-ups on the stories above.
